'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Tom H LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom H]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
